name: Scout
summary: A skirmisher and explorer who stays one step ahead.

features.name: Skirmisher
features.short: Reaction: move half speed away when an enemy approaches.
features.summary: When an enemy ends its turn within 5 ft. of you, you can use your reaction to move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Survivalist
features.short: Nature and Survival with double proficiency.
features.summary: You gain proficiency in Nature and Survival, with double your proficiency bonus for checks with them.

features.name: Superior Mobility
features.summary: Your walking speed increases by 10 ft. (and your climbing and swimming speeds, if you have them).

features.name: Ambush Master
features.short: Advantage on initiative; your first target is easier to hit.
features.summary: You have advantage on initiative rolls. The first creature you hit in the first round becomes easier to hit: others have advantage on attacks against it until your next turn.

features.name: Sudden Strike
features.short: Bonus action attack that can Sneak Attack a second target.
features.summary: If you take the Attack action, you can make one additional attack as a bonus action. It can benefit from Sneak Attack even if you already used it this turn, but not against the same target.
